**[P2] Preserve the synthetic root’s cross-invocation envelope**

Because the clock is re-anchored for every invocation, this terminal timestamp can precede spans exported by an earlier invocation after a backward wall-clock adjustment. The new −60 s test permits the first `Invocation` to end after its `DurableExecutionRoot`, even when the same plugin instance handles the resume. Retain a per-execution high-water mark for emitted SDK boundaries and clamp the terminal Workflow/root end to it; then assert containment for the process-local backward-step case.
